record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

concern.question: Which rates apply to this quarter?

says: Alice founds a Team on her laptop, registers its knowledge source and commits a revision, and her enrolled desktop imports it by peer, so the revision has a copy on each device. A read scoped to the Team and to that source delivers its one unit with the frontier it read at. The derivation map of the revision names two distinct derivatives, an excerpt and an index. A retention plan promises the revision and lists the index as evictable, apart from it. One batch then removes the excerpt and the index on the laptop and sends the plan to the desktop by peer; its result states each item's own outcome under its carrier, local and peer, with a receipt each. Finally removing the revision returns a removal_outcome with one row per copy (laptop and desktop, each confirmed with its tombstone) and each derivative's own rows. What must not happen: the read reaching past the Team's scope or the named source, the two derivatives counted as one, the batch summarised into one outcome across carriers, or a removal stated once for all copies.
